channel.title: Latest F1 News
channel.description: Don't miss a Formula 1 moment – with the latest news, videos, standings and results. Go behind the scenes and get analysis straight from the paddock.

item.title: Stewards issue verdict over Verstappen yellow flag incident
item.description: Max Verstappen has avoided a grid penalty for Saturday’s Sprint race in Singapore after being investigated for allegedly breaching yellow flag regulations during Sprint Qualifying.
item.dc:creator: Formula 1

item.title: Hadjar assesses ‘very poor performance’ in Singapore
item.description: While Max Verstappen took pole in Sprint Qualifying at the Singapore Grand Prix, Red Bull team mate Isack Hadjar faced a difficult session en route to ninth place.
item.dc:creator: Formula 1

item.title: McLaren pair divided over ‘very tricky’ Sprint Qualifying
item.description: McLaren's Oscar Piastri and Lando Norris placed fourth and fifth respectively in Sprint Qualifying at the Singapore Grand Prix.
item.dc:creator: Formula 1

item.title: Ferrari 'not fast enough' in Sprint Qualifying – Leclerc
item.description: Charles Leclerc believes Ferrari were "just not fast enough to fight" for pole position in Sprint Qualifying ahead of the Singapore Grand Prix this weekend.
item.dc:creator: Formula 1
